comment: Deleted #15 OTHER_LAW "Art. 93 VE": the text is "Art. 93 VE-ZPO", an article of the 2003 preliminary draft of the federal ZPO. The proposal cut the abbreviation, and a draft bill is neither cantonal, foreign nor supranational law, so it fits none of the nine classes. If the guideline wants drafts as OTHER_LAW, the span would be "Art. 93 VE-ZPO".
